Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1045
Claimant:
Lisa Pierce
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
4-13-24
Claim reported by the insured after a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured reports neck and
shoulder pain and says the claimant's vehicle was stopped in front of them when the impact occurred. The driver is
confirmed as a named driver on the policy.
5-2-24
Claimant is now represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their office. A letter of
representation has been received and logged. Medical authorization requests have been sent.
5-17-24
Stateemnts from two witnesses, scene photographs and the other driver's account all agree that the collision
happened as the insured described. Initial damage estimate reviewed; the damage is mostly consistent with the
reported impact speed and direction.
8-21-24
Claimant's recorded statement was taken today. Some details were added compared with the first report, but the core
account has not changed. It is still not fully clear from the statement or the photos where in the vehicle the claimant
was seated at impact.
9-6-24
A neighbor has told us they believe the vehicle had body damage several weeks before the claimed date. We have
no independent record of earlier damage to the vehicle, and no prior calims on it are on file. The neighbor's comment
has been noted for follow-up.
10-25-24
Medical records show a shoulder injury that is plausible for a collision of this type. Treatment followed a usual course
and tapered off as the claimant improved. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the records received
so far.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
